metadata.certifiedDate: Certified for Tax Year 2026 by Passaic County Board of Taxation
metadata.sourceAgency: Passaic County Board of Taxation & Wayne Township Tax Collector

location: Wayne Township, Passaic County, New Jersey

breakdown.description: Funds 14 public schools educating ~7,520 students, instructional programs, and special services.

components.name: Regular Instruction & Classrooms
components.description: Teacher salaries across 14 schools, curricula, AP/STEM programs

components.name: Employee Health & Pension Benefits
components.description: State medical/prescription benefits, statutory pension employer charges

components.name: Special Education & Out-of-District Tuition
components.description: Specialized IEP instruction, therapy, and county vocational tuition

components.name: Operations, Facilities & Plant Maintenance
components.description: School building upkeep, utilities, HVAC, and campus security

components.name: Student Transportation & Busing
components.description: Contracted routes and busing across township territory

components.name: Administration & Business Office
components.description: Superintendent, business office, school principals, audit, legal

components.name: Student Support, Guidance & Athletics
components.description: Counseling, nursing, extracurriculars, and varsity sports

breakdown.description: Funds local municipal operations including Police, Public Works, Parks, Sanitation, Library, and emergency services.

components.name: Police Department & Public Safety
components.description: Patrol, detectives, emergency dispatch, traffic safety, and equipment

components.name: Statutory Pensions (PFRS/PERS) & Health Insurance
components.description: Employer statutory retirement and group health plan contributions

components.name: Department of Public Works (DPW) & Roads
components.description: Road maintenance, snow plowing, sanitation/recycling, and parks upkeep

components.name: Municipal Debt Service & Capital Notes
components.description: Bond repayments, interest, infrastructure capital funds

components.name: Fire Protection & EMS
components.description: Fire apparatus, volunteer stipends, hydrants, and emergency response

components.name: General Administration, Legal & Finance
components.description: Mayor & Council, Business Admin, Clerk, Tax Assessor, Legal Counsel

breakdown.description: Apportioned share of Passaic County operations, funding County Roads, Sheriff, Jail, County College, and Regional Parks.

components.name: County Law Enforcement & Sheriff
components.description: Sheriff patrols, jail, prosecutor's office, court security

components.name: County Roads, Bridges & Public Works
components.description: Major thoroughfares, traffic signals, drainage, and bridge maintenance

components.name: Health, Social Services & Welfare
components.description: County welfare board, public health, nursing facilities

components.name: County College & Technical Schools
components.description: County College and Vocational-Technical School District funding

components.name: County Parks, Open Space & Administration
components.description: Regional park system, recreation, county clerk, board of commissioners
